attribute.ddprofessions.charisma.descrip: Each point over 10: +0.1 luck. Trading and faction standing come later.

class.ddprofessions.archer.description: A marksman. Skill tree: the Archer path. Passive: +5% ranged damage.

race.ddprofessions.dragonborn.descriptio: Draconic: a little larger, and can breathe fire in a cone ahead (racial ability key, H) every 30 seconds.
race.ddprofessions.dwarf.description: Stout and short. Darkvision underground (below sea level, out of the sky), and mines all ore 25% faster.
race.ddprofessions.elf.description: Light-footed: takes no damage from falls of up to 5 blocks, and their arrows fly 10% faster.
